purpose: Isolate the fine pre-attachment trajectory/NQC input spacing while keeping the whole-waveform output chart at 0.5 M and the ODE tolerance fixed.
interpretation: This isolates fine trajectory sample spacing from the whole output cadence and coarse restart chart. It still combines fine ODE resampling with NQC spline input density and cannot by itself prove source fidelity, physical accuracy, full-domain convergence, or ROM qualification.
